findings: Completed-trips filter uses `.every()` instead of `.some()` (or first-date check), causing the section to almost always fall back to trendingTrips.slice(0,3) and display non-completed trips with a misleading 'COMPLETED' badge. Fix: change to `new Date(t.startDates[0]) <= now`.

TripCard.tsx uses next/image with unconstrained `trip.coverImage`. Safe for current whitelisted hosts but will crash the /trips page at runtime for any image URL from a non-whitelisted domain. Add a fallback src or widen remotePatterns.
All BlogCard hrefs and the 'Read all stories' link point to the stub anchor `#blog`. Should be tracked as a known placeholder before shipping.
